limitations: Only the 16 self-contained CPU tests were run for the patch, using --noconftest; the full TensorRT/Polygraphy suite was not run.
Inputs supplied only to the external --check command are outside the reducer's input loader and cannot be counted by this guard.
The guard also rejects invariant branches across multiple iterations; it does not prove invariance.
provenance.scope: Conservative rejection of multi-iteration branch freezing; not general support for multi-input reduction.
provenance.submission_status: Issue discussion posted; patch has not been submitted as an upstream pull request.
